Currently no save button invokes it (embedding.hbs only has add_host), so nothing breaks today, but the mechanism is real and grounded in the diff: any future use of the update path would silently succeed without persisting. This is a substantive, specif

adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb) does not apply any params or persist anything; it simply re-serializes `@embedding` (an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding`) the same way `#show` does. On the client, `saveChanges()` in `app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, which will issue a PUT to `/admin/customize/embedding` (via the new adapter). There is currently no save button wired to `saveChanges` in `embedding.hbs`, and the actual persistence happens per-host via `EmbeddableHost#save`, so this is not a user-visible broken flow today, but it is a real, diff-grounded “no-op update endpoint + client action” mismatch that could silently appear successful if later connected to UI/API expectations.
